what_it_does: Proposes a hardware accelerator that performs large language model attention computation inside specialized memory (processing-in-memory or PIM) rather than in distant main memory. The key insight is that attention has two distinct phases: scoring (comparing queries to keys) and context weighting (applying scores to values), which have different computational patterns. The accelerator dynamically adapts its processing for each phase and uses token-level parallelism to keep the memory bank units balanced.
